law.catch_line: Certification of certain persons employed in mineral mines; powers of the Department

text.section: Certification shall also be required for any additional tasks that the Department requires by regulation.

The Department may adopt regulations necessary or incidental to the performance of duties or the execution of powers conferred under this title. Such regulations shall be adopted in accordance with the provisions of Article 2 (§ 2.2-4006 et seq.) of the Administrative Process Act.
